clauses.explanationTr: Bu sözleşme, sizin ve Spotify’ın arabuluculuk yoluyla anlaşmazlık çözmesini zorunlu kılıyor. Mahkemeye gitmek yerine arabuluculuk yapılacak ve sınıf davaları, jüri hakları gibi haklarınız yok.
clauses.quote: Either you or Spotify may start arbitration proceedings. Any arbitration between you and Spotify will be administered by National Arbitration and Mediation ("NAM") in accordance with their rules applicable to the nature of the Dispute, including the Comprehensive Dispute Resolution Rules and Procedures and/or the Supplemental Rules for Mass Arbitration Filings ("NAM Rules"), as modified by this Arbitration Agreement.
